title: Sparse block encoding with low subnormalisation for quantum linear solvers on unstructured meshes
summary: Unstructured meshes are widely used in modelling and simulation in Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) due to their geometric flexibility. However, they require an efficient block encoding circuit describing the system. Here, we present a new block encoding methodology for unstructured mesh solvers based on decomposing the system matrix into a sum of 1-sparse matrices. This block encoding is engineered to reduce subnormalisation even in the absence of structure by hiding the contribution of large matrix elements behind others.
